title: Ordinary launcher accounting: recognize split named libtest result lines
outcome: Pinned named live runs retain exact-name and count checks while accepting a sequential libtest status split from its test-name line by diagnostics.
acceptance: For sequential named live runs, the launcher pairs each libtest test-name prefix with its completed ok or FAILED status even when diagnostics split them across lines; it still requires every requested name exactly once and matching terminal counts.

Focused Node regression checks cover split successful and failed statuses, missing or truncated statuses, unrelated test names, duplicate results, count mismatches, and executeRun PASS/FAIL accounting without weakening child-exit or exact-selection checks.

The original B16 runs (test-da554d1a and test-8f8af9ff) remain preserved with the runner diagnosis. The repair landed with its own required review pair and standard full gate, and the post-landing rerun of the pinned 25 live tests was recognized by the launcher as PASS.
